title: Records of licensees.
bodyText: The board of agriculture and biosecurity may require licensees to keep such records and information as it deems necessary for the proper enforcement of this chapter.
bodyHtml: §157-26  Records of licensees.  The board of agriculture and biosecurity may require licensees to keep such records and information as it deems necessary for the proper enforcement of this chapter. [L 1967, c 260, §17; HRS §157-26; am L 2025, c 236, §18]
